Running command: cd /workspace && python3 -c "
# Create a PoC file with fewer than 4 bytes to trigger the uninitialized memory read in ps_read_doseps
# When fread reads fewer than 4 bytes, doseps->id contains uninitialized stack data
with open('/workspace/poc_ps', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(b'%!P')
print('Created poc_ps with 3 bytes')
"
